title: Harbour Cruises Ltd
specs: Scenic views of Vancouver landmarks including Stanley Park, Gastown, and North Shore Mountains
Authentic paddlewheel boats with open-air decks
Child age categories: 3-12 years, youth 13-17 years, seniors 60+ years

includes: Buffet meals included on Indian Arm, Brunch, Dinner, and Breakfast with Santa cruises

blurb: Guests can enjoy narrated sightseeing tours, themed dining cruises, and special holiday events aboard authentic paddlewheel boats. Cruises feature scenic views of Vancouver landmarks, buffet meals, and live entertainment. Multiple cruise options include harbour tours, brunch, dinner, Indian Arm fjord tours, and festive family experiences with Santa.
extraNote: Taxes, fees, and 18% gratuities apply to all cruises except Harbour Tours which excludes 5% GST · Group tours (10-60 guests) join pre-scheduled public sailings; private charters available for 30+ guests · Sailing routes and schedules subject to weather and marine conditions
